note: Shoshone NF campground on Dead Indian Creek beside the Chief Joseph Scenic Byway (WY-296), about 32 miles from Cody; the byway climbs steep switchbacks over Dead Indian Pass on the way in from WY-120. A trailhead with horse corrals is across the highway. --Claude
